materials_exhausted.notes: Primary XML, OA-package article PDF/text, supplementary PDFs/text, package manifest, and linked DBAASP/DRAMP rows were reopened. Supplementary assets support NMR/chiral-HPLC structure work and add no activity/toxicity tables.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 preserved DBAASP/DRAMP endpoint, unit, subject-precision, sequence/topology conflicts instead of silently source-verifying them; citation links are verified to the primary paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered source-supported GI50 cancer-cell rows for similanamide and antibacterial MIC non-activity rows from the primary bioactivity paragraph, with explicit no-unit rationale for GI50.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: No direct mechanism assay is present; mechanism layer is accepted only as unknown_or_not_tested with phenotype-level activity/non-activity context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: The prior ticket is closed because the missing activity rows and database conflict adjudication are now represented with source locators and caution findings.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP cytotoxicity rows use IC50 with ug/ml, while the reopened primary paper text reports GI50 values and no visible GI50 unit.

Primary text supports reference-strain and resistant-isolate antibacterial non-activity at MIC >256 ug/mL, but some database rows add exact ATCC/MDR subject precision not recoverable from the local paper text.
DRAMP sequence/topology metadata does not faithfully encode the primary-source cyclic nonstandard-residue structure; conflict preserved.
The paper reports phenotype-level activity/non-activity only; no direct mechanism claim is accepted.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed re-review recovered the paper-local activity evidence and preserved database conflicts; the paper is publication-grade with cautions, not clean acceptance.
